messages:
Ravi: Quick run-through — aiming to push the launch post this Thu 10am PT. Need volunteers: final hero line, bench stat + tiny methodology note, production UI screenshot, top-of-post webinar CTA with email prefill, HubSpot hidden fields + UTMs, and a legal quick-pass. Low-churn thread pls. :rocket:

Carmen: Ill take hero + bench phrasing. Will avoid absolutes and add a 1-line methodology parenthetical. Two hero options by EOD.

Eli: Ill grab the screenshot from staging and export hero crops (1200x630 + @2x). Which route is the demo on?

Priya: Ill build the HubSpot form and hidden fields. Plan: hidden fields `lead_source=blog_launch`, `product_interest=inference`, `orig_utm`. Will support `email` prefill via `?email=`. Also will wire UTMs for cta_A/cta_B.

DesignBot: Uploaded hero candidates: https://drive.redwood/marketing/launch_hero_set.png. Recommend primary crop 1200x630 and social crop 1200x628.

Marta (Legal): On benchmark language: switch "reduces cost by 60%" -> "internal tests show up to 60% reduction in per-token inference cost" and add a short note about runner and baseline. Also flag any claims about "99.99% uptime"  avoid unless we can attach SLA doc.

Carmen: Got it Marta. Draft bench line: "Internal tests on representative prompts show up to 60% reduction in per-token inference cost (10k requests; 8xA100 baseline; end-to-end measurement)." Pushed to /content/drafts/launch_post.md.

Ravi: Good. For hero, two options: A) "Production-ready LLM inference that scales" B) "Fast, reliable inference with predictable cost"  which do we favor for organic vs paid?

Priya: Use B for paid ads; A for organic. Ill map UTMs as `?utm_source=redwood&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=launch_q2&utm_content=hero_a|hero_b`. For A/B testing set `utm_content=hero_a` and `hero_b` respectively.

Eli: Screenshot capture route `console.redwood.com/demo?view=stream`  will scrub org names, capture token panel and config sidebar. Exported and uploaded.

DesignBot: Also included a small CSS suggestion to tighten CTA spacing:

```
.blog-hero .cta { margin-top: 20px; display:inline-block; }
```

Carmen: Quick legal tweak acknowledged. Removed any SLA-like phrasing. Replaced hero wording in doc and added bench footnote.

Marta (Legal): Re-reviewing. One small ask: for the methodology blurb, please avoid revealing internal config details like exact batch sizes. Keep it high level (baseline hardware, sample size, end-to-end).

Carmen: Edited the methodology to be high level per Marta. New line: "(10k request sample; baseline: 8xA100; end-to-end response time and cost measured)."

Priya: About prefill: HubSpot can prefill email via `?email=`. Ill also append `orig_utm` and `lead_source`. Hidden fields added to the form and tested.

Ravi: Lead routing rules: company_size >= 500 -> Enterprise AE queue; else SMB SDR queue. Also flag `product_interest=dedicated` as high-priority. Priya please document SFDC mappings.

Priya: Done. Added SFDC mapping doc and routing rules to runbook.

Eli: Screenshots uploaded and optimized (1200x630 + retina). No real org data included.

DesignBot: Optimized images and generated webp variants.

Marta (Legal): Final sign-off contingent on bench language staying high-level and removal of SLA claims. Approved. :white_check_mark:

Carmen: Hero + bench + methodology done and pushed. :white_check_mark:

Eli: Screenshots + exports done. :white_check_mark:

Priya: HubSpot form + hidden fields + UTMs + prefill tested. SFDC mapping documented. :white_check_mark:

Ravi: Thanks all  scheduling for Thu 10am PT. Ill drop the publish checklist in #release-war-room when scheduled. :tada:
